# secret/public-env-name

Secret in a browser-exposed env variable.

An environment variable with a prefix the framework ships to the browser (NEXT_PUBLIC_, VITE_, PUBLIC_, EXPO_PUBLIC_, REACT_APP_, ...) whose name says it holds a secret.

- Default level: `block`.
- Looks at: each file in scope, on its own.
- References: [CWE-200](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/200.html), [CWE-798](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/798.html), OWASP A04:2025.

## Why it matters

Frameworks copy every variable with a public prefix into the JavaScript bundle, so its value is readable by anyone who opens the site. Renaming a server variable with NEXT_PUBLIC_ is a common agent "fix" when a value is undefined in the browser.

## Flagged

`.env.example`:

```sh
NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENAI_API_KEY=
```

`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`:

```yaml
NEXT_PUBLIC_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL }}
```

`app/checkout.tsx`:

```tsx
const secret = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY;
```

`src/lib/admin.ts`:

```ts
export const admin = createClient(import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL, import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY);
```

## Not flagged

- `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=` in `.env.example`: URLs are public
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=` in `.env.example`: the anon key is public by design
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY=` in `.env.example`: PostHog project keys are public
- `Never name a key NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENAI_API_KEY; it ends up in the bundle.` in `README.md`: documentation is not checked
- `const publishable = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY;` in `app/checkout.tsx`: publishable key
- `export const other = import.meta.env.PUBLIC_DATABASE_URL;` in `src/lib/admin.ts`: PUBLIC_ is only a public prefix in SvelteKit and Astro

## How to fix

Keep the secret in a server-only variable (no public prefix) and call it from a route handler, Server Action, or server function; rotate the key if the site was deployed with the public name.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore secret/public-env-name: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "secret/public-env-name": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
